prompts: Create a production transparent PNG game title logo, isolated with generous transparent margins, wide landscape 3:2 composition. Exact title text 'THE LAST PATCH', absolutely correct spelling. Layout: small 'THE' above a bold 'LAST' line and bold 'PATCH' below it; compact unified logo for upper left corner of a game main menu. Original 90s N64/PS1 harbor adventure game lettering: chunky carved cream/cheese ivory letters with beveled angular corners, deep warm dark wood and rusty metal edging, restrained pixel-painted texture and fine dithering, a few small stitched olive burlap patches and tiny faded pink accents. Easy to read at small scale, avoid excessive frame ornaments. A small dark near-black SILHOUETTE of a fisherman mouse with distinct two round ears, a hat and thin fishing rod sits ON TOP OF one letter, rod curves slightly toward title. Mouse silhouette subtle but identifiable; no detailed colored character. Rustic maritime adventure, old wood #7A5230, olive #565E3D, cream #F1D997, small pink #F27999 accents. Genuinely transparent background, no checkerboard baked in, no scene, no wall, no extra words, no tagline, no watermark, no photorealism, no modern glossy chrome, no neon. Premium cohesive game brand, polished retro handpainted detail, clear silhouette and enough contrast for sunset background.

Create a small discreet original game monogram icon for 'The Last Patch': ONLY the three readable capital initials 'TLP', intertwined compactly as a single elegant angular symbol, not resembling any existing luxury brand's double-letter mark. Square composition, genuinely transparent PNG background with generous clear margins. Cream ivory/cheese yellow ink with a dark brown thin outline and tiny weathered wood/stitched olive accent; very restrained fine pixel-painted N64 adventure aesthetic, rustic harbor fishing theme. A subtle fishing hook can form the lower curve of P but all T L P remain legible. Flat clean emblem that reads at 32 to 64px; no frame, no medallion, no long words, no busy texture, no 3D scene, no neon, no checkerboard baked in. It should pair with a carved ivory title logo and wooden buttons.

Edit this wooden game UI button: remove the word START completely and cleanly, leaving the center as uninterrupted plain old wooden planks with subtle painted grain. Preserve the same rectangular button shape, rusty metal clamps, rivets, patched burlap corners, warm brown and olive palette, retro pixel-painted N64 game art. This is an EMPTY background button template onto which the game will draw labels. Transparent outside the button, no text anywhere, no icon, no checkerboard baked in. Keep the wide roughly 3:1 aspect ratio and generous padding around the silhouette. High quality clean edges.
